messages:
sylvia: Heads-up: launching a compact trial win-back + newsletter funnel next week. Goal = trial -> first successful inference within 7 days. Need segments, cadence, owners. Launch Wed 10am PT.

jack: Proposed segments: trial_new (0-72h), trial_stalled (4-14d), newsletter_inactive (30+ days no open).

li: For trial_new: Day0 welcome + 1-click quickstart, Day2 sample app, Day5 benchmark highlights. Keep CTAs code-first.

omar: trial_stalled: win-back subject test (stat vs curiosity). Add a 1-question micro-survey on Day2. I can build the flow in Customer.io.

elaine: I'll make 3 subject variants and short preview text. Example subject: "Your first inference in 3 minutes" or "Cut inference cost 2x today".

jack: Analytics: define activation = created_api_key + first_success. I'll drop CSV segments and UTMs. utm_campaign=trial-winback-apr.

newsletter-bot: campaign skeleton `trial-winback-apr` created.

sylvia: Owners: copy=elaine, flow=omar, lists=jack, analytics=jack. Final review Tue 9am PT. Share previews by EOD. :rocket:
